profile_text.body:
Shopify Inc. is a public company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario, traded under the ticker SHOP and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001594805. On its own website the company describes itself as an all-in-one commerce platform for businesses, offering a free trial and tools to manage every part of a business rather than ecommerce software alone. It says businesses can build or grow quickly with AI.

The site's AI material centers on a product it calls Agentic Storefronts. Shopify says this lets merchants get discovered across AI channels and lets shoppers check out directly in the chat, with the company describing the process as requiring no action from the merchant.

The record holds no litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers for the company.
